title: node-live
description: A node's page as the working copy's revision of it would make it, over today's design: read as a release's node, planned as today's design plans a release, and laid over it for this request only. Said so, with what it changes, what the plan withholds and why, what the copy's file says that a release does not bring into today's design, and the sources it cites that sources/ does not list. Nothing of today's design is written or run; or why not.

message.description: Why nothing is drawn: no copy, no node file, a node today's design does not hold.

opened.description: The SHA-256 of the node file as it was read.

not_taken.description: What the copy's file says, where it differs from today's page, that a release does not bring into today's design: its question and its explanation's three texts.

changes.description: What the plan applies: a field, or the version it records.

withheld.description: What the plan does not apply, and why: a conflict, a refusal, a decision waiting for its record, a transcription taken as an assistant's relation.

open.description: Every source it cites that sources/ does not list.

drawn.description: Whether the revision is drawn over today's design: false when it does not plan or does not load over it, and the page is then today's.

changes_nothing.description: The revision changes nothing on today's page, and the page is today's.

said.description: What the page is, in a sentence.
